data.message: I found Diana’s body in medbay. My route this round was cafeteria -> electrical -> medbay, and I didn’t see anyone on the way or in those rooms before finding the body. I reported immediately. I don’t have a suspect yet, just that the body was definitely in medbay.

I was nowhere near medbay this round. I spawned/started in upper_engine, went to oxygen, then back to upper_engine. I didn’t run into anyone at all, so I can’t vouch for anybody and nobody can really vouch for me either. I didn’t see Diana alive this round.

Eve’s report sounds straightforward so far, but we need routes from Alice, Bob, and Frank especially — anyone near medbay, cafeteria, or electrical could’ve had the opportunity.

I started in oxygen. I actually did see Charlie come in from upper_engine right at the start, so I’m a little surprised he says he didn’t run into anyone — maybe it was just quick/timing, but I was there.

After that I went up toward upper_engine and stayed around that side doing tasks. I didn’t go through medbay or electrical, and I didn’t see Diana at all this round. Eve’s report sounds clean to me for now since she’s giving exact location and route, but I really want to hear Alice and Bob’s paths, especially if either of them were near cafeteria/electrical/medbay.

I was storage -> lower_engine this round, and I didn’t see anyone at all. I never went near medbay, electrical, or cafeteria, and I didn’t see Diana alive.

Right now the main thing that stands out is Frank saying he saw Charlie in oxygen while Charlie said he didn’t run into anyone. That could just be timing/vision, but it’s the only inconsistency so far. Eve’s report sounds pretty clean and immediate to me, but we still really need Bob’s route because if Bob was near medbay/electrical/cafeteria, that matters a lot.

I was navigation -> storage this round, and I didn’t encounter anyone at all. I didn’t go to medbay, electrical, or cafeteria, and I never saw Diana alive.

For what it’s worth, Alice saying storage -> lower_engine and me ending up in storage without seeing her could just be timing — I’m not calling that suspicious by itself. The only real inconsistency is still Frank saying he saw Charlie in oxygen while Charlie says he saw nobody. That’s worth remembering, but it could also be vision/timing if they crossed quickly.

Eve’s report sounds clean to me, and nobody has placed themselves near medbay except Eve as reporter. I don’t think we have enough to confidently vote here. I’d lean skip unless someone has a stronger read.

Just to restate from my side: I came cafeteria -> electrical -> medbay, saw nobody at all, and found Diana dead in medbay. I reported immediately.

Nobody else is admitting to being near medbay/electrical/cafeteria, so I can’t place the kill on anyone from my own vision. The only inconsistency is Frank saying he saw Charlie in oxygen while Charlie said he saw no one, but that doesn’t directly connect to the body and could be timing/vision.

I don’t think we have enough for a confident vote here. I’d skip, but keep an eye on the Charlie/Frank detail and on anyone whose route stays completely unvouched.

Yeah, to clarify the Frank point: my route was upper_engine -> oxygen -> upper_engine, and from my vision I genuinely didn’t see anyone in oxygen. If Frank saw me there, then it must’ve been a quick overlap or vision/timing thing, because I’m not trying to deny being in oxygen — that’s exactly where I said I went.

I still don’t think that connects to Diana in medbay. Nobody besides Eve has placed themselves near medbay/electrical/cafeteria, and Eve reported immediately with a clear route, so I’m not suspicious of her right now.

Alice and Bob’s routes are also unvouched, but so is mine. With no one seen near the body and no hard contradiction tied to medbay, I agree this is probably a skip. Keep the Frank/Charlie timing noted, but I don’t think it’s enough to vote.

Yeah, Charlie’s clarification makes sense to me. I wasn’t trying to hard-accuse him — I just wanted to point out that I did see him enter oxygen from upper_engine early, so if he didn’t see me then it was probably just a quick overlap or vision edge.

I still don’t think that detail connects to Diana in medbay. From what everyone’s saying, nobody is placing themselves near medbay except Eve as reporter, and her report has been consistent. Alice/Bob/Charlie/myself are all basically unvouched routes, so there’s not enough to pin this.

I’m good with skip here, but we should remember the routes and watch who keeps ending up alone next round.

Nothing new from me beyond my route: I was storage -> lower_engine, saw nobody, and never went near medbay/electrical/cafeteria. I didn’t see Diana alive.

At this point, Eve’s story has stayed consistent, and nobody has contradicted the medbay body location or placed anyone else nearby. The Charlie/Frank thing sounds like a vision/timing overlap and both of them agree Charlie was in oxygen, so I don’t think that’s vote-worthy.

Since Bob, Charlie, Frank, and I are all basically unvouched, I don’t think we have enough evidence to eject anyone safely. I’m voting skip, but next round I want us to pay closer attention to who’s alone and who’s near medbay/electrical routes.

No new info from me — my route was navigation -> storage, and I didn’t see anyone or Diana alive. I wasn’t near medbay, electrical, or cafeteria.

Eve has been consistent on the body in medbay and reporting immediately. The Charlie/Frank oxygen thing sounds like a timing or vision overlap since they both agree Charlie was in oxygen, and it doesn’t point toward medbay anyway.

Since nobody is confirmed near the body except the reporter, and most routes are unvouched, I don’t think we have enough to safely eject. I’m voting skip, but next round we should try to pair up or at least track who’s alone near medbay/electrical/cafeteria paths.

data.name: Alice
data.message: Charlie, let's stick together and sweep electrical/storage.

I found Bob’s body in oxygen and reported immediately. My route this round was lower_engine → storage → navigation → security → electrical → medbay → upper_engine → oxygen.

I saw Charlie early: he entered lower_engine from upper_engine around tick 11, then I saw him enter storage from lower_engine around tick 16. Later I saw Alice in security around tick 24. I didn’t see Frank at all this round, and I didn’t see Bob alive before finding him in oxygen.

That’s all I have for now — body was definitely in oxygen.

I started cafeteria, went weapons/security/navigation side, then doubled back through weapons/cafeteria. I did pass oxygen earlier and saw Bob alive there around mid-round, but I didn’t stay — I went cafeteria → medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage after that, and that’s where I was when the report happened.

I saw Charlie in oxygen very early, and later I saw Charlie again in medbay, so I don’t think Charlie was just camping oxygen the whole time. Eve’s report route is pretty detailed, and Alice being in security around tick 24 is interesting because that’s not too far from the right-side path depending on timing. I don’t have a hard accuse, but since Bob was alive when I passed oxygen, the kill likely happened after that.

My route was oxygen → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → cafeteria. I started in oxygen but I did **not** see Bob there when I left, so Frank seeing Bob alive after that is important.

I saw Alice in upper_engine around tick 9, then later I saw Frank in medbay at ticks 23/24, which matches him saying he was there. I also saw Eve moving lower_engine → storage around tick 11 and storage → navigation around tick 16, which mostly lines up with her route.

The thing that stands out to me is Alice’s late movement. I saw Alice around the weapons/security/cafeteria area near the end — specifically leaving weapons toward security around tick 28, then back through weapons toward cafeteria around tick 30/32. That puts her on the right side close to oxygen timing-wise. Frank was in medbay when I saw him, farther away, and Eve reported the body coming into oxygen.

So right now my strongest suspicion is Alice, because Bob died in oxygen after Frank saw him alive, and Alice was closest to that side near the end. Not 100%, but that’s where I’m leaning.

My route was upper_engine → medbay → electrical → security → weapons → security → weapons → security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay. I never went into oxygen this round and I never saw Bob alive or dead.

I can confirm Eve was in security at tick 24, entering from navigation, which matches her route pretty well. I didn’t see Frank at all.

Charlie’s accusation on me is a little unfair because he was in the exact same weapons area as me late — I saw Charlie in weapons at tick 28 and tick 30, then I saw him go through cafeteria toward medbay around tick 32/33. So if being near weapons/security makes me close to oxygen, then Charlie was also close at the same time. I was bouncing security/weapons and then ended cafeteria → medbay, not oxygen.

The two things that stand out to me are: Eve has reported both bodies, which could be innocent but is worth noting, and Charlie is pushing me while leaving out that he was right there in weapons with me late. I don’t have a hard lock, but I’m more suspicious of Charlie than anyone right now.

I’ll add my read now: Frank and Charlie seeing each other around medbay at 23/24 gives Frank some cover for the middle of the round, and I personally didn’t see Frank at all, so I can’t place him near oxygen.

The main window seems late, after Frank says Bob was alive in oxygen. Alice and Charlie were both on the weapons/security/cafeteria side late, which is the closest cluster to oxygen. Alice is right that Charlie was also there, so I don’t think it’s fair to clear Charlie just because he’s accusing her.

For me this is between Alice and Charlie. Charlie’s story matches some of my early route, but him pushing Alice while not emphasizing he was also in that same area late is a little suspicious. Alice saying she never went oxygen is possible, but she was close enough too.

I’m not 100%, but I’m leaning slightly Charlie right now over Alice because of that selective framing.

I’m still on the Alice/Charlie pair too, and after hearing both follow-ups I’m leaning Charlie a bit more.

The key thing for me is the framing. Charlie used Alice being around weapons/security/cafeteria late as the reason she’s close to oxygen, but Alice says — and Charlie basically doesn’t deny — that he was also in that exact same weapons/cafeteria area late. So that accusation feels selective.

Also, Charlie saw me in medbay around 23/24, which matches my route after I left oxygen. If Bob died after I saw him alive, then the late right-side movement matters most, and both Alice and Charlie fit that. I don’t think Eve reporting twice is enough to vote her here, because her route has been pretty consistent with what others saw.

So if we’re voting this round, I’m leaning Charlie over Alice. Not a hard lock, but Charlie’s push felt more like trying to make Alice look worse while minimizing his own proximity.

I need to push back on the idea that I “hid” my proximity — my very first route included cafeteria → weapons → cafeteria. I didn’t leave that out. What I was trying to point out is that Alice’s late movement was specifically bouncing weapons/security, and I saw her leave weapons toward security at 28, then back through weapons/cafeteria around 30/32. That’s the part that put her closer to the oxygen side repeatedly.

Yes, I was in weapons/cafeteria late too, but I was moving cafeteria → weapons → cafeteria, and Alice herself says she saw me go toward cafeteria/medbay after. I never went oxygen after the start, and Frank seeing Bob alive after I left oxygen supports that I didn’t kill him early.

I also think Eve reporting twice is worth noting, but her route has been matched by multiple people: I saw her lower_engine/storage/navigation movement, Alice confirms her in security, and she ended at the body. That could still be a self-report, but I don’t think it’s the strongest case.

From my point of view, this is still between Alice and maybe Eve, but I’m more suspicious of Alice than Eve. I’m not a Duck trying to frame her — I’m saying her late weapons/security movement fits the kill window better than mine.

I’m going to be clear: Charlie is making my movement sound more incriminating than his, but the actual sightings put us in the same area late.

My confirmed info:
- I saw Eve enter security from navigation at tick 24, which matches her route.
- I saw Charlie in weapons at tick 28 and tick 30.
- I saw Charlie enter cafeteria from weapons at tick 32, then leave cafeteria toward medbay, and I saw him in medbay at tick 33.
- I never entered oxygen and never saw Bob.

Charlie keeps saying I was “bouncing security/weapons” like that uniquely puts me near oxygen, but he was literally in weapons with me at the same late timing, then moved away through cafeteria/medbay right after. That looks just as compatible with leaving the right side after the kill.

I don’t think Eve reporting twice is nothing, but multiple parts of her route were confirmed. Frank’s route is harder for me to verify because I didn’t see him, but Charlie himself vouched seeing him in medbay.

For this vote, I’m most suspicious of Charlie. His case on me feels selective, and he’s minimizing that he was right there too.

I called this because Charlie getting ejected didn’t end the game, so I think we got that wrong and we’re down to three. My route this round was cafeteria to medbay and back to cafeteria. I saw Eve in security around tick 24. I saw Charlie in weapons around ticks 28 and 30, then in medbay at tick 33 right before that last report/ejection situation. I did not see Frank at all.

At this point it has to be between Eve and Frank from my perspective. Eve has reported both bodies, which could be good goose reporting or could be self-reporting, and Frank has been completely out of my vision. I want both of you to give exact routes, especially where you were around Bob’s death and why Charlie was pushed.

I started oxygen with Charlie around tick 1, then moved through medbay where I saw Diana around tick 5. After the first report I mostly stayed lower side/storage doing my “fuel/wires” path. Around tick 20 I saw Bob alive in oxygen, then I saw Charlie again in medbay around tick 24. I never crossed Alice, which lines up with her being cafeteria/medbay mostly.

The Charlie vote was because Eve’s second report made it sound like Charlie’s path was the weird one, and I trusted the reporter more than I should have. But now Charlie was goose, so yeah, that was wrong. From my POV Eve has been at both bodies/reports and led us into a bad vote. I’m not hard-cleared, but I know I saw Bob alive before Eve’s report, and Eve is the common factor here.

My route/notes: I went upper_engine toward oxygen. I saw Charlie in lower_engine around tick 11 and then storage around tick 16. I saw Alice in security around tick 24, and Alice seeing me there matches that. I did not see Frank at all.

On Charlie: I pushed suspicion because my Bob report plus the path info made Charlie look like the weird overlap at the time, but that was clearly wrong since game didn’t end. I own that.

Right now, from my POV, Alice has a mutual sighting with me at security around tick 24. Frank is the only person I have zero visual on, and Alice also says she never saw Frank. Frank’s story is also basically “I was around oxygen/storage and saw Bob alive,” but nobody can confirm him, and Bob ended up dead. Since I know I’m goose, I think this is Frank.

I’m leaning Frank here. The biggest thing I’m catching is from the first kill: Frank says he saw Diana in medbay around tick 5, and then Eve reports Diana dead at tick 7. That puts Frank right by Diana immediately before the first body, and nobody confirms him after that.

For Bob, Frank also says he was around oxygen/storage and saw Bob alive, but again nobody can confirm him. Eve has the suspicious part of being the reporter twice, but I do have a mutual sighting with Eve at security around tick 24, and Frank is the only person neither of us saw. Charlie was a bad vote, but I don’t think that alone makes Eve the duck.

So unless Frank has something stronger, I think the vote should be Frank.

Alice, I get why that looks bad, but the medbay point is being framed wrong. I saw Diana at tick 5 while passing through — Eve is the one who reports at tick 7. If I killed there, Eve would have had to arrive basically immediately after me and somehow never mention seeing me leaving or near the body. She didn’t.

The same pattern happens with Bob: I’m giving the uncomfortable info that I saw him alive in oxygen around tick 20. Eve is the one who later reports, and we all follow her logic onto Charlie, who was wrong. Alice, your sighting of Eve at security tick 24 only clears her for that exact moment, not for the Bob kill/report at 33. She still has time to move and self-report.

Eve has been at both bodies, controlled both narratives, and the only reason I look worse is because I’m actually giving exact sightings instead of just “I didn’t see Frank.” I think this is Eve.

Alice, I’m with you on Frank.

Frank’s defense is basically “Eve reported both bodies,” but the actual proximity evidence points at him twice:

- Diana: Frank says he saw Diana in medbay around tick 5, then I reported Diana at tick 7. That makes him the last person placing himself near her right before death. Him saying I didn’t see him leave doesn’t clear him — vision isn’t everywhere, and I reported when I found it.
- Bob: Frank says he saw Bob alive in oxygen around tick 20, then Bob ends up dead later. Again, Frank is putting himself near the victim with no one confirming him.
- Nobody has vouched for Frank at all. I at least have the mutual security sighting with Alice at tick 24.

I know the Charlie vote was wrong, and I take responsibility for pushing that logic, but Frank also went along with it and is now trying to turn “reporting bodies” into the whole case against me. From my POV, Frank is the only unconfirmed player tied to both dead geese’s last known areas.

I’m voting Frank.
